atoms.b: AI is developing rapidly and will continue to do so. Future predictions suggest that it will increasingly affect our ((everyday_lives)).

For example, developers are trying to move AI away from their ((cloud-based)) processing redesign devices to run AI directly on the device. This means that phones, cars and smart homes could each host their own AI independently of large AI ((databases)), which could make AI more efficient and affordable.

AI is improving ((computer_vision)) by facilitating increasingly accurate image and video analysis. This, in turn, improves the performance and reliability of smart technologies, such as ((autonomous)) cars and medical diagnostic systems.
Raw internet data used to train AI might be replaced by synthetically generated data that mimics ((real-world_patterns)), which could improve data privacy.

Furthermore, AI might help us become more environmentally friendly. While we live in an economy that is highly ((wasteful)) in its use of water, fossil fuels and energy sources, smart systems of the future could ((facilitate)) a much more circular, less wasteful and sustainable global economy.

flip.text:
On-device AI
Enables AI to operate offline on a phone and greatly improves data privacy, because data is only processed on the device.

Computer vision in cars
Improved computer vision will enable cars to identify their surroundings in real time by detecting traffic signs, pedestrians and other vehicles, so they could drive fully independently.

Synthetically produced training data
The training data is artificially generated and can therefore be adjusted, such as to avoid bias in real-world data.

atoms.b: Naturally, AI will increasingly take over human work. However, in the future, it might not only take over basic jobs but also manage entire ((business_procedures)) such as assessing demand, designing products or recruiting new employees.

It sounds like science fiction, but with the help of AI, we will be able to create ((digital_twins)), accurate simulations of objects and even people, allowing us to predict how ((lifestyle_changes)) or certain medication could affect them.
Humans might enhance their physical abilities by implanting AI-powered ((nanotechnology)) into their bodies. This could help cure diseases, make people feel fitter, happier and more productive.

Even education could be reformed by AI. Pupils might be provided with ((personalised_learning_programmes)) in digital simulations, specifically tailored to their needs based on their DNA or biometric data, instead of standardised textbook exercises.
